grid.layout_notes: 5×4; Wild Geisha is 4-row high on reel 3. Ways 1,024 expanding up to 12,288.

win_system.notes: 1,024 ways expandable to 12,288 via sliced wilds / expansions.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Sliced Wilds expand to 2/3/4 wilds on reels 3/4/5; in free spins copy downward before slice. Wild Geisha nudges fully visible on reel 3.

other.name: Oni Transform
other.how_it_works: Bonus + stacked Samurai → transform into best paying symbol present; also upgrades lower stacked Samurai to that symbol.

other.name: The Wild Geisha (xNudge)
other.how_it_works: 4-row Wild on reel 3; always nudges fully visible; +1 win multiplier per nudge step.

wilds.name: Sliced Wild
wilds.behavior: Single wilds on reels 2–5 (except Bonus). Sliced into 2/3/4 wilds on reels 3/4/5. In Shogun/Geisha copy downward to bottom row before slice.

wilds.name: The Wild Geisha
wilds.behavior: 4-row high on reel 3; nudges fully visible; +1 mult per nudge. With 3 Bonus at trigger → Geisha Spins. During Shogun, landing Geisha upgrades to Geisha Spins with extra spins = multiplier achieved.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3 Bonus → 8 Shogun Spins (+1 per extra Bonus). 3 Bonus + Wild Geisha → 8 Geisha Spins. Extra Bonus during Geisha +1 spin.

specials.name: Samurai (stacked)
specials.behavior: With Bonus, Oni Transform upgrades to best paying symbol on reels.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on 5×4 (1024→12288 ways). Sliced Wilds on 2–5; Wild Geisha xNudge on reel 3. Bonus+Samurai can Oni Transform. 3 Bonus → Shogun 8 (guaranteed wild each spin); Geisha present upgrades to Geisha Spins with sticky nudge mults. Buy Shogun 75× / Geisha 700×.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop; Geisha nudges if partial; sliced wilds apply; Oni Transform if Bonus+stacked Samurai.

modes.name: Shogun Spins
modes.retrigger: Additional Bonus at trigger +1. Upgrade to Geisha by landing Wild Geisha during Shogun; extra Geisha spins = multiplier achieved.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: ≥1 guaranteed single wild on reel 2–5 each spin. Sliced wilds copy downward before slice.
modes.end_condition: Spins done, upgrade to Geisha, or Journey's End 30,000×.

phases.name: Shogun
phases.what_happens: 8+ spins with guaranteed wilds; possible Geisha upgrade.

modes.effects: 8 FS guaranteed wilds; upgradeable to Geisha.

modes.name: Geisha Spins
modes.trigger: 3 Bonus + Wild Geisha at once, or upgrade from Shogun.
modes.spins_awarded: 8 natural; extra spins equal to xNudge multiplier when upgrading/awarding; +1 per extra Bonus.
modes.retrigger: +1 Geisha spin per extra Bonus during bonus.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Each Geisha nudge awards sticky multiplier; ≥1 guaranteed wild on reels 2,4 or 5 each spin.

phases.name: Geisha
phases.what_happens: Sticky nudge mults; guaranteed wilds; Bonus retriggers.

modes.effects: Premium FS with sticky Geisha nudge multipliers.

features.name: Wilds & Sliced Wilds
features.effects: Wilds on 2–5; slice 2/3/4 on reels 3/4/5; copy down in FS.

features.name: Oni Transform
features.effects: Transform to best paying symbol present.

numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 21.54%; free spins ~1 in 205; win 100× ~1 in 1,179.

BUSHIDO WAYS xNUDGE
Honour, Respect, Tribute, Glory, Fear and
Revenge - Learn the way of the Warrior with
Nolimit City in Bushido Ways xNudge!
The game features a 5x4 reel area, 1,024 ways that can
expand up to 12,288 ways to win, Wilds / Sliced Wilds, Oni
Transform and The Wild Geisha.

Every so often, Bushido Warriors spins their way into the
lucrative Shogun Spins - which is the free spins feature of
the game. Simultaneously landing a Wild Geisha turns the
Shogun Spins into the even more lucrative Geisha Spins!

The most honourable and fearless Bushido warriors get to
experience The Journey’s End - which is only achievable by
reaching the maximum payout of the game, 30,000x.

## Shogun Spins
When landing 3 Bonus symbols, 8 Shogun Spins are awarded. Any additional Bonus symbol that lands awards +1 Shogun Spin. For every spin, at least one guaranteed single wild will land on reel 2, 3, 4 or 5. It is possible to upgrade to Geisha Spins by landing The Wild Geisha during Shogun Spins. Extra Geisha Spins are awarded equal to the multiplier achieved.

## Geisha Spins
When landing 3 Bonus symbols at the same time as the The Wild Geisha lands, 8 Geisha Spins are awarded.\nFor each nudge the The Wild Geisha does, a sticky multiplier is awarded.\nExtra Geisha Spins are awarded equal to the xNudge multiplier. +1 spin is awarded if landing an extra Bonus symbol. +1 Geisha Spin is awarded if landing extra Bonus symbols during the bonus rounds. For every spin at least one guaranteed single wild will land on reels 2, 4 or 5.

## Wilds & Sliced Wilds
There are single position Wilds on reel 2, 3, 4 and 5 and they substitute for any other symbol except for the Bonus symbols.
